envelope.command: gh api repository metadata, branches, main protection, Actions workflows, pull requests, and releases for EOS, Equilibrium, and Regression; gh api repos/ePC-SAFT/ePC-SAFT-engine

user_approval.source: explicit Codex task request on 2026-08-04 to begin the full ePC-SAFT package cutoff with Lithium and MEA deferred

observations.name: source_repository_identity
observations.expected: Public, unarchived EOS repository with stable ID R_kgDOTZ9m0Q and protected main.
observations.observed: ePC-SAFT/ePC-SAFT-eos is public and unarchived; main rejects force pushes and deletion with admin enforcement.

observations.name: accepted_candidate
observations.expected: One hash-bound cp313 Engine wheel from c712fe9730faef0732341ccdabc4d799fef2d953.
observations.observed: G4 passed for wheel SHA-256 21ed202df4aa5f8a516aa6400a3a09fe9b5e1d267935f6c5411b92e8faf9d049; installed-wheel Engine and Validation suites passed.

observations.name: transition_archive_subjects
observations.expected: Equilibrium and Regression are unarchived, have no releases or conflicting open pull requests, and their cutover branches are clean.
observations.observed: Both repositories satisfy the expected state and retain stable IDs R_kgDOTZ9n6A and R_kgDOTZ9ogA.

observations.name: deferred_consumer_scope
observations.expected: The three deferred applications are quarantined and excluded from package-cutoff writes and admission.
observations.observed: D-024 records Lithium Extraction, MEA Thermodynamics, and MEA Absorption Column as non-admitted until later migrations pass.

observations.name: metadata_and_recovery_exports
observations.expected: Hash-bound repository settings, branches, protections, workflows, releases, redirect limits, artifact indexes, ordered requests, and per-step recovery.
observations.observed: The G6 GitHub, artifact, and ordered-operation exports capture all requested subjects and their SHA-256 hashes.

observations.name: rename_and_archive_behavior
observations.expected: Known redirect, namespace-reuse, archive, and unarchive behavior with accepted losses stated.
observations.observed: Official GitHub behavior is recorded; no package repository has Pages or Actions workflows; old-name reuse is forbidden; archiving is reversible by unarchive; accepted_losses is empty.

preconditions: Doctrine revision 9 and D-024 are merged before the repository rename.
Engine main resolves exactly to c712fe9730faef0732341ccdabc4d799fef2d953 before release creation.
The target namespace remains unoccupied immediately before rename.
Main protection continues to reject force pushes and deletion.
No write is made to a D-024-quarantined downstream repository.
expected_postconditions: Repository R_kgDOTZ9m0Q is named ePC-SAFT/ePC-SAFT-engine with protected main at the accepted Engine commit.
GitHub release v0.2.0.dev0 contains the accepted wheel and its downloaded SHA-256 matches.
Governance exposes one active epcsaft artifact and no active separate Equilibrium or Regression distribution.
Equilibrium and Regression are archived after release validation but before the no-install authority transaction.
A completed G7/G8 state receipt records exact remote and local outcomes.
The three quarantined applications remain unchanged and unsupported pending later migrations.
record.retry: Retry an idempotent metadata read or upload once; stop on any identity, commit, hash, protection, or namespace mismatch.
stop_conditions: The target namespace becomes occupied by a different repository.
Engine main differs from the accepted commit.
The uploaded or downloaded wheel hash differs from the accepted candidate.
Repository identity or main protection is lost.
Any operation would require changing a quarantined downstream repository.
A partial authority state cannot be completed without accepting two active package channels.
record.reversibility: The repository rename is reversible while the old namespace redirects and remains unclaimed. Git commits and release metadata are recoverable. Artifact aliases can be restored from the recorded pre-cutover index.
irreversible_effects: The GitHub rename and release publication become durable public events.
Archiving transition repositories changes their public writable state until explicitly unarchived.
